content:
olivia: Quick heads-up 1:30 UTC tonight we'll run a preemptive NIC microcode flip + kernel micro-updates in us-west2 GPU pool. Target window 23:30-02:30 UTC (rolling). Plan: 3-phase canary -> cohort -> pool-sweep with staged backfill to us-east1 and eu-west1.

sam: How much capacity lost at peak? any chance Dedicated tenants notice the shift?

olivia: Peak effective capacity reduction ~25% while cohorts are rebooted. Dedicated customers in us-west2 with pinned zones will be contacted; for hosted traffic we'll steer to backfill zones. No data-plane changes, just routing shifts.

devin: Suggest we throttle the batch size for the first cohort to reduce KV cache cold-start. Also add a short warm-seed step after each rack reboot.

olivia: Agreed. Operation steps: drain -> reboot -> kv-prime -> health-check. Example drain command: `./ops drain-node --rack r16 --grace 90s --evict-tasks`

leah: Cost note: cross-region egress + burst GPUs estimated $2.6k baseline. If we need extended backfill >90m could hit $4.5k. Recommend a cost gate for finance.

sam: Can we automate gating? i.e., if error-rate or p95 latency spike breach, pause further cohorts.

devin: We have an automation hook: `opsflow trigger --on metric:api.errors>0.02 for 10m --action pause-backfill` but product needs to ACK auto-pause.

olivia: Product giving conditional OK for manual gating only. We'll run automation in monitoring-only mode and ops will manually pause if thresholds hit.

infra-bot: maintenance_scheduled id=MW-20260512-W1 window=23:30-02:30 UTC pools=[gpu-uswest2] runbook=<https://go/redwood/runbooks/uswest2-nic-microcode|runbook>

leah: Comms: Draft message sent to `#acct-dedicated` and `#cs-ops`: "Planned maintenance in us-west2 on May 12 UTC window 23:30-02:30. We will failover to us-east1/eu-west1. Brief performance impacts possible. No data loss expected."

sam: Oncall? who is primary for node reboots and who will run the KV prime?

olivia: Oncall primary: devin, backup: leah. Please be available 22:45-03:30 UTC. Devin will run KV prime.

devin: I'll post the canary checklist 60m before start. Will include rack IDs, exact drain order, and the probe commands.

leah: Probe suggestion: `curl -s https://internal/kvprobe?pool=gpu-uswest2 | jq .hit_rate` aim >=0.88 after warm-seed. Also `curl -s https://internal/latency?region=us-east1 | jq .p95` to ensure fallback SLOs.

sam: Add cost kill-switch: if projected cross-region spend > $3.8k or unhandled errors > 2.5% for 15m, ops will halt and escalate to finance + product.

pager-bot: reminder set for 2026-05-12T22:45:00Z to post canary checklist and start watch.

olivia: One more networking ask: avoid ASN-level swaps. We'll use L7 weights + BGP community nudges. Keep sessions stable to reduce convergence.

devin: noted. Also enable increased log-level for model-variant routing so we can correlate any quality blips during temporary quantized fallbacks.

leah: ok. I'll own customer comms and cost monitor. We'll reconvene here 22:30 UTC for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
